title: Frappe ERPNext 5.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 5.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in the Projects module. This flaw allows authenticated users, including those with minimal privileges such as portal users or users without roles, to access employee costing and billing rates by sending crafted requests referencing records outside their permission scope. The vulnerability arises because the endpoint does not enforce record-level permission checks.
